lines.t: Casinos are designed so you lose track of time… and money. Here's how.
lines.title: CASINO *MIND GAMES*

lines.t: One. Chips instead of cash. A plastic chip doesn't feel like real money, so it's easier to bet more.
lines.title: CHIPS ≠ *CASH*

lines.t: Two. Near misses. When the slot stops one symbol away from a jackpot, brain studies show it lights up reward areas, almost like a win.
lines.title: THE *NEAR MISS*

lines.t: Three. Losses disguised as wins. You bet a dollar, win fifty cents, and the machine still celebrates with lights and music.
lines.title: SLOT MACHINE

lines.t: And four. Free drinks and comps. They're not gifts. They keep you playing longer.
lines.title: NOTHING IS *FREE*

lines.t: Follow for more psychology tricks used on your wallet.
lines.title: KNOW THE *GAME*
